symptoms: review preview rendered specimens implausibly large
large portions of canopy/leaves extended outside the review frame
young variants appeared at mature-like scale
review could not reliably judge in-garden integration

rootCause: Pilot QA review incorrectly reused production physical-scale runtime for an uncalibrated source photo.
The production scale path intentionally allows clipping in estimated mode and is designed for interactive Garden Design with manual resize, not bounded QA comparison.
Pilot QA hard-coded NATURAL_MATURE review scenario even for young assets.
In-Garden QA contract already requires small/medium/large review scales; the pilot review had drifted from that contract.
invariants: In-Garden QA must remain usable when a real saved Garden photo exists but meter calibration does not.
QA preview scale must not silently become botanical meter truth.
Young assets must not inherit a mature-only scenario.
All review scales must remain bounded and fully visible.
Production Garden Design scale behavior is evaluated separately from QA review presentation.
next: Re-render four pilot candidates on the real Garden photo at bounded small/medium/large scales, then perform owner visual gates.
